news.summary: Key TakeawaysSnap opened Specs preorders at $2,195 in June, but with fall nearly over, the AR glasses still have no confirmed ship date. Meta Platforms plans its own AR glasses for 2027, while Apple priced its Vision Pro at $3,499, so Snap could be first and cheaper.

news.title: Musk: FAA Said Free Starlinks Were “Not Needed.” Verizon Holds the Contract for the New System

Musk has a point about the FAA’s network, but the dispute is too small to change the case for Verizon or SpaceX stock.

news.summary: Intuitive Surgical, Inc. (NASDAQ:ISRG - Get Free Report) EVP Gary Loeb sold 400 shares of the company's stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, November 10th. The stock was sold at an average price of $458.15, for a total value of $183,260.00. Following the transaction, the executive vice president directly owned 6,236 shares of the company's stock, valued at approximately $2,857,023.40. The trade was a 6.03% decrease in their ownership of the stock. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through this link. The transaction was executed under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan.

news.title: Oklo Rises 4% as DOE Clears Groves-1 Reactor for Unrestricted Operations: “Reset the Nuclear Industry’s Expectations”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo shares jumped 4% today after the Department of Energy cleared its Groves-1 test reactor for unrestricted operations. Groves-1 shows Oklo can build fast, but it still needs a cost for its first Aurora powerhouse and a binding customer.

Oracle has the most at stake: Steve Eisman puts about half of its $664 billion backlog with OpenAI, and its free cash flow was negative $23.
